subject: Dedicated capacity demo / throughput intake — Stratuslytics
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@stratuslytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 Jan 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: Dedicated capacity (600 qps target)

Hi Karthik,

I signed up via your self-serve flow late yesterday and got routed to SDR outreach — thanks for following up. We're evaluating Redwood for a production pilot and need a Dedicated setup to meet latency and throughput needs. Brief details:

- Target steady-state throughput: ~600 qps (mixed short/long sequences)
- 95th p50 latency target: <= 300ms token-level for typical 128-token responses
- Peak concurrency: up to 40 concurrent sessions; burst to 100 for short windows
- Models under consideration: open Llama-variant family (quantized)

We'd like a short technical demo to walk through how Dedicated maps to throughput, batching, and KV/prefix caching. Ops will join as well (copying ops@stratuslytics.com).

Attached a quick throughput-profile CSV — it's noisy but should give an idea of distribution. Please suggest 30–45 minute slots next week.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, Stratuslytics
maya.patel@stratuslytics.com

Attachment: throughput-profile.csv (CSV, 14KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@stratuslytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 Jan 2028 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: Dedicated capacity (600 qps target)

Hi Maya — great to see the signup and thanks for the details. I'm Karthik from Solutions Engineering; Ben (cc) will help run the Dedicated intake. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can tailor the demo:

- Can you confirm typical sequence length distribution (median and 95th)? your CSV hints at bimodal.
- Is the 600 qps steady-state for single region? Any multi-region needs?
- Are you planning to pin a model version for the pilot, or do you want fallback variants?
- Any compliance constraints (retention, private deployment) we should surface during demo?

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed Jan 11, 10:00–10:40am
- Thu Jan 12, 9:30–10:00am (30m)
- Fri Jan 13, 1:00–1:45pm

If none of these work, share a couple slots and we'll adapt. I'll attach a short intake checklist Ben uses so we can confirm datapoints ahead of the call.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: intake-checklist.md (text, 3KB)
